query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM poi_reviews
            WHERE account_id = $1 AND poi_id <> $2 AND lower(body) = lower($3)
              AND updated_at > now() - interval '30 days'
        ) OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM reviews
            WHERE account_id = $1 AND lower(body) = lower($3)
              AND updated_at > now() - interval '30 days'
        ) AS "e!"
